==Yabunonaka (In the bush) in Lojban==

*a Lojban translation of ''[http://www.aozora.gr.jp/cards/000879/card179.html Yabunonaka (In the bush)]'' by Ryunosuke Akutagawa translated by [[la guskant]], and
*maybe parsed by [http://guskant.github.io/gerna_cipra/maltufa-1.1.html Maltufa_1.1 a.k.a. Zantufa Ugly].
